answer: Your records list no allergies. The allergy list is empty in all three sets of records I can see, which run from February 2024 to October 2026. An empty list does not prove you have none. It may mean no allergy was ever recorded, or that nobody asked. If you know of a reaction to a medicine, food or anything else, tell your care team so it can be added. Your current medicines are atorvastatin and Jardiance, and nothing in your records mentions a reaction to either.
short: No allergies are recorded in my records from 2024 to October 2026. That may mean none were documented, not that none exist.
